title: Spiced Black Pudding Fritters
description: Crispy fritters filled with the rich flavors of black pudding, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the crumbled black pudding, chopped onions, and saudi arabian spices.
2. Mix well until the ingredients are evenly distributed.
3. Divide the mixture into 6-8 portions, depending on the desired size of the fritters.
4. Shape each portion into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
5. Heat the kadhai or vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
6. When the oil is hot, add 2-3 fritters to the pan and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
8. Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
